basis: TDK B66285/B66286 ELP22/6/16 drawing pages 2–3, October 2022; geometric tolerance screen, not physical fit acceptance

axial_note: Computed as two times (5.7-0.1 minus 3.2+0.1), excluding process-controlled mask thickness; board centering is assumed, not guaranteed.

Physical clip clearance and installation force; clip bow is not fully dimensioned
Core vertical location and underside clearance in actual standoffs/fixture
No extra gap spacer, ferrite grinding or substitution without magnetic review
Winding insulation and actual Lm/leakage/core-loss qualification
